## Checklist

- [ ] Follows the [Style Guide](https://zi-yue-1129.github.io/ai-wiki/reference/style-guide/) (own words, sources cited, no cross-page heading anchors)
- [ ] New pages are in `nav` in `mkdocs.yml` (with a `nav_translations` entry for zh-TW)
- [ ] Pages that also belong to other categories are linked with `related` (and `tags`) in front matter
- [ ] Ticked the topic on the Roadmap's missing-topics list, if it was there
- [ ] `mkdocs build --strict` and `python scripts/wiki_status.py --check` pass locally
- [ ] Translation updated, or left for later (the status report will flag it)
